panels.description: The Alpha display changes from emergency command status while the civic hall watches. Keep upper display clear.
Across the hall, white-and-amber nodes shift from command amber to steady white. Keep upper nodes clear.
A maintenance node continues routing water and payroll without issuing a new allocation. Keep upper node clear.
Old ownership, allocation and debt ledgers remain on the wall beneath a new human-review marker. Keep upper ledgers clear.
